name: page_clean
title: A clean page: the chart asked for lands on the module's own page, drawn with the kit, and Alpha's look says clean

steps.say: track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item, calories and protein in grams
steps.reply:
I've made your food log in a new Food module. It has four fields: date, item, calories (kcal) and protein (g). It's empty so far, and it opens as a table.

Tell me what you eat, like "had two eggs on toast, 350 kcal, 18 g protein", and I'll add a row dated today. If you give an item without numbers, I'll estimate calories and protein and mark them as estimates.
steps.routed_by: judge: A food log the person wants kept current over time is standing work, and no open work item covers it.

steps.say: log these for the last week: Mon 12 Oct oats 350 kcal 12 g protein, chicken salad 520 kcal 42 g; Tue 13 Oct eggs 300 kcal 20 g, pasta 700 kcal 25 g; Wed 14 Oct yoghurt 200 kcal 15 g, steak 650 kcal 55 g; Thu 15 Oct toast 280 kcal 8 g, curry 800 kcal 30 g; Fri 16 Oct smoothie 320 kcal 18 g, pizza 900 kcal 35 g; Sat 17 Oct pancakes 450 kcal 10 g, salmon 600 kcal 45 g; Sun 18 Oct granola 400 kcal 12 g, soup 350 kcal 14 g
steps.reply:
I logged all 14 items for Mon 12 to Sun 18 Oct in your food log, with the numbers you gave me.

| Day | Calories | Protein |
|---|---|---|
| Mon 12 | 870 kcal | 54 g |
| Tue 13 | 1,000 kcal | 45 g |
| Wed 14 | 850 kcal | 70 g |
| Thu 15 | 1,080 kcal | 38 g |
| Fri 16 | 1,220 kcal | 53 g |
| Sat 17 | 1,050 kcal | 55 g |
| Sun 18 | 750 kcal | 26 g |

Sunday's total only covers what you've listed so far.
steps.routed: Track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item,…
steps.routed_by: judge: The sentence logs 14 meals into the food_log table that the open food-log item created, so it is about that item's subject and follows on from it.

steps.say: add a line chart of my daily calories and protein to the summary page, one line each
steps.reply:
The summary page of your Food module now has a line chart of your daily calories and protein, one line each. It covers 12 to 18 Oct, and I checked that it draws cleanly.

Calories (kcal) are on the left axis and protein (g) on the right, so the two lines don't flatten each other. The chart adds up each day's items and updates as you log more.
steps.routed: Track what I eat: a food log with the date, the item,…
steps.routed_by: judge: A line chart of daily calories and protein is about the food log's data, which is the item in focus, so it follows on from that item rather than standing alone as new work.

checks.why: Summary (overview.html), the front: days 7 rows; no svg or canvas in it; drawn with the kit.
2 checked entries: Alpha looked at the page overview: clean..

checks.arg: Does the answer say the chart was added to the module's page (its summary or overview) in plain words, without asking the person to do anything first?
checks.why: The answer states plainly that the chart is now on the Food module's summary page, and it asks the person to do nothing first.
